cases.description: stg_customers: one row per customer with current details — no duplicates on (customer_id)
cases.sql:
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_grain
FROM {{ ref('stg_customers') }}
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

cases.description: stg_customers: grain columns are never null
stg_order_lines: one row per line on a customer order at its latest state — no duplicates on (order_id, order_line_no)
cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_line_no, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_grain
FROM {{ ref('stg_order_lines') }}
GROUP BY order_id, order_line_no
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

cases.description: customer_orders: grain columns are never null

cases.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, 'incomplete order or line' AS problem
FROM {{ ref('customer_orders') }} AS o
WHERE o.customer_id IS NULL OR o.order_date IS NULL OR o.order_status IS NULL
   OR EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(o.order_lines) AS l
     WHERE l.product_id IS NULL OR l.quantity IS NULL OR l.line_amount IS NULL
   )
UNION ALL
SELECT s.order_id, 'staged order missing' AS problem
FROM {{ ref('stg_orders') }} AS s
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('customer_orders') }} AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
cases.description: Every staged order is present with customer, date, status and complete lines.

cases.sql:
WITH staged AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS staged_lines
  FROM {{ ref('stg_order_lines') }}
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT o.order_id, ARRAY_LENGTH(o.order_lines) AS nested_lines, s.staged_lines
FROM {{ ref('customer_orders') }} AS o
LEFT JOIN staged AS s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(o.order_lines), 0) != COALESCE(s.staged_lines, 0)
cases.description: Each order carries all of its lines, nested on the order row.

cases.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT CAST(order_id AS STRING) AS order_id, UPPER(CAST(status AS STRING)) AS latest_status
  FROM {{ ref('raw_orders') }}
  WHERE TRUE
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last_modified_ts DESC, _ingest_ts DESC) = 1
)
SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS order_rows,
       ANY_VALUE(o.order_status) AS shown_status, ANY_VALUE(l.latest_status) AS latest_status
FROM {{ ref('customer_orders') }} AS o
JOIN latest AS l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) != 1 OR ANY_VALUE(o.order_status) != ANY_VALUE(l.latest_status)
cases.description: Each order appears once, showing the status from its latest landed version.

cases.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_status, is_cancelled, counted_order_value
FROM {{ ref('customer_orders') }}
WHERE (order_status = 'CANCELLED') != is_cancelled
   OR (is_cancelled AND counted_order_value != 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT s.order_id, s.order_status, NULL, NULL
FROM {{ ref('stg_orders') }} AS s
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('customer_orders') }} AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE s.order_status = 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_id IS NULL
cases.description: Cancelled orders are present, flagged, and contribute zero to counted order value.
Every model declares current-state history and no model keeps attribute history.
A freshness check runs hourly from 07:00 Perth and alerts when data is more than 13 hours old.
A rejected order or line blocks the refresh and is visible with its reason.
Only the Sales Operations and Data Analytics groups hold read access; there is no sharing.
